title: Compare six Wire change plans against independent clean JVM runs
description: Discover the Retrofit 2.6.0 public converter operations on both deployments, reach their concrete original methods through the public factory, and compare full finite results after cache, test-resource, deployment-resource and classpath-order changes. Record separate historical and additional denominators and actual work and cost.
expected: All six controls agree with clean original-entry recomputation. Both registered reads survive, and both added writes reproduce NoSuchMethodError on the intended runtime.
